counting.description: Each working set adds the exercise's muscle rating (0-1) to that muscle. Ratings below 0.25 count as 0 (noise). Weekly total = sum over all tiles of sets x rating.

session.description: Per-session effective sets (same fractional counting). light = meaningful stimulus, solid = full productive hit, heavy = top of useful range; beyond heavy is junk volume. Use for day-mode shading only, not a target check.

heads.description: Head ratings in exercises.json (heads) drive map shading only. Weekly targets and the volume panel stay at the muscle-group level using muscles ratings. Day-mode head shading uses the parent group session anchors.

levelMinFactor.note: Multiply each muscle min by this for the selected level (round to 0.5). Max is unchanged. Beginners grow on lower weekly volume, so a 10-set floor would push them toward junk volume.

gradient.description: Body map load shading, used in both Week and Day views. The fill goes untrained grey, then light to dark in the base hue as load climbs to the 'full' point, then shifts toward amber and on to red past the overload point. Interpolate in a perceptual space (OKLCH), or linearly between the stops.

week.basis: weekly effective sets vs that muscle's targets (min scaled by levelMinFactor)

stops.note: hard switch to green at min, no blend between blue and green

day.basis: that day's effective sets vs session anchors (session.muscles light/solid/heavy) and the junk cap

examples.chest (heavy 10): dark at 10, fully amber at 12, red at 16
examples.lower_back (heavy 5): dark at 5, fully amber at 6, red at 8

day.note: No blue in day view: one session is not meant to reach a weekly minimum. Green from first set to darkest at heavy, then amber/red.

curve.position: p = sqrt(min(sets, heavy) / heavy); 0 sets stays untinted grey
curve.note: sqrt spreads out the low end: 1 of 10 sets lands at p=0.32, 3 at 0.55, 5 at 0.71.

day.ramp_note: Interpolate color and opacity between ramp stops in OKLCH. Past heavy, keep the existing amber at heavy*1.2 and red at heavy*1.6 (opacity 0.95). Each step is a large lightness jump so it reads clearly on the grey base.

legend.note: Blue segment up to the min/solid tick, then a hard step to light green, green to dark at max/heavy, then amber and red.

gradient.estimated: Custom-exercise loads keep the hatch overlay on top of this fill.

curve.model: S(x)=1-exp(-x/k), x = weekly effective sets after session discount; output is relative stimulus 0-1, a model not a measurement

session_discount.note: effective sets past 10 for a muscle in one session count at 50%

recovery.fatigue_field: exercises[].fatigue (1.5 heavy axial compound, 1.2 other compound, 0.8 isolation)
recovery.week_cost: sum of sessions; show as % of user's saved baseline week (first saved week if none set)

modifiers.baseline: baseline stores modifiers as saved; current modifiers apply to the current week only

recovery.note: Rough estimate. Adjust to how you actually recover.

analytics.spf: rating/fatigue per muscle; suggest swap when another exercise rates >= rating-0.1 for that muscle with higher spf; only within the same movement pattern (rules.json patterns), never compound to isolation
analytics.disclaimer: Model for comparing plans, not a measurement of growth or recovery.
